messages.text: How do changes in radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

### Short answer
Changes in radar technology increase the required tester capability mainly in **bandwidth / frequency coverage, echo and object emulation, Doppler / velocity accuracy, antenna / beamforming verification, and possible communication-sensing convergence**, while the passages only directly describe these as radar-echo-generator, CMX signaling/non-signaling, ISAC, and beamforming facts rather than one integrated “Signaling / Non-signaling Tester” requirement statement [6][7][13][18][50][55][87].
### Supported details
| Radar-technology change | Measurement capability implicated by the passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| FMCW radar and digital echo generation | The radar test setup needs digital echo generation for FMCW radar, with generated distance from the radar-under-test air gap value up to 3000 m [6]. | [6] |
| Longer / dynamic artificial object scenarios | The AREG800A is described as dynamic artificial object generation, using hybrid short-distance analog stepped delay line for `< 17 m` and fully digital implementation for longer distances up to `3000 m` [6]. | [6] |
| Wider radar IF bandwidth | The AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth depends on option and is `1 GHz`, `2 GHz`, or `5 GHz`, with measured overrange of `1.2 GHz`, `2.2 GHz`, or `5.2 GHz` [50]. | [50] |
| Higher-frequency automotive radar bands | The supported RF frequency bands include `24 GHz to 24.25 GHz`, `76 GHz to 81 GHz`, and external frontend coverage `24 GHz to 44 GHz`, so the measurement setup must match the radar band being tested [50]. | [50] |
| More complex object / channel configurations | One AREG800A base unit supports up to 4 conventional mmWave frontends, up to 8 QAT100 frontends, or up to 8 FE44S external frontends configured as 4 TX and 4 RX pairs [50]. | [50] |
| Doppler / velocity requirements | Each artificial object supports individual Doppler frequency shift, velocity setting range with AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63 is `±500 km/h`, velocity step size is `0.001 km/h`, Doppler frequency offset accuracy is `< 1 Hz` in the IF domain excluding frontend, and velocity accuracy is `< 0.05 km/h` under the stated 78 GHz / 79 GHz conditions [55]. | [55] |
| Beamforming / phased-array radar directionality | Beamforming is described as increasing antenna gain by bundling transmitted energy and directing it toward the user, and the cited solution-level test view includes beamformer IC verification for phased array antennas plus 2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification [87]. | [87] |
| Communication-sensing convergence such as ISAC | ISAC integrates sensing capability into communications networks, and its challenges include high bandwidth, radar equation, power density, spectrum coexistence, and waveform design [18]. | [18] |
| Satellite / 6G-style convergence | Multi-function satellite services may integrate a joint waveform such as communications plus radar sensing, or use a communications method to provide timing information [71]. | [71] |
| Signaling tester role | The CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD, and it provides NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements plus WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements [7]. | [7] |
| Non-signaling tester role | The CMX500 GPRF Generator is a non-signaling use case that generates ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveform, supporting R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [13]. | [13] |
### 推論
【推論】If radar evolves toward FMCW, wider bandwidth, more objects, and Doppler-sensitive scenarios, the relevant measurement capability shifts from only RF power/frequency checks toward radar echo generation with distance, object, bandwidth, and Doppler controls, because AREG800A provides FMCW digital echo generation, up to `3000 m` generated distance, `1 GHz` / `2 GHz` / `5 GHz` IF bandwidth, and individual Doppler / velocity specifications [6][50][55].
【推論】If radar evolves toward phased-array or beam-steered operation, the tester setup needs antenna / beamforming verification in addition to RF signal analysis, because the cited beamforming passage describes phased-array beamformer IC verification and 2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification [87].
【推論】If radar evolves toward ISAC or communications-plus-radar sensing, a signaling / non-signaling tester context may need to combine protocol/network-emulation or waveform-generation roles with sensing-related RF requirements, because CMX500 covers signaling and non-signaling waveform / TX workflows while ISAC and MFSS passages describe sensing integrated into communications and joint communications-plus-radar waveforms [7][13][18][71].

6G NTN waveform / air interface research 包含：

- OFDMA enhancements。

- [[FDSS]]：降低 PAPR，改善 uplink-constrained NTN power efficiency；來源稱可改善 link budget 約 4 dB 到 5 dB。
- ECRA / grant-free IoT access：結合 asynchronous retransmission 與 SIC receiver，用於大量 small packet IoT access。
- circular constellation mapping、APSK、semantic coding、joint-source-channel coding。
- NOMA、full duplex、flexible TDD、multi-radio shared spectrum。

[[MFSS]] 是將 communications、navigation、earth observation、monitoring、sensing 等 satellite services 整合的概念。

- Phase 2：可能整合 joint waveform，例如 communications + radar sensing，或 communications method 提供 timing information。

6G NTN 展望 › Two-stage network access model
來源引述 [[6G-TakeOff]] 提出 UE network access 的 two-stage model：

| Stage | 功能 |
|---|---|
| Anchor part | 提供 downlink synchronization signals、system information、uplink random access；適合 camping、first access、initial connectivity。 |
| Dynamic part | 由 non-permanently visible dynamic cells 組成；較適合 connected mode，UE initial access 後由 network handover 到 dynamic node。 |

此模型的動機是降低 UE 在 idle mode 長時間掃描 dynamic network nodes 的 power consumption。

### Short answer
Changes in radar technology increase the required tester capability mainly in **bandwidth / frequency coverage, echo and object emulation, Doppler / velocity accuracy, antenna / beamforming verification, and possible communication-sensing convergence**, while the passages only directly describe these as radar-echo-generator, CMX signaling/non-signaling, ISAC, and beamforming facts rather than one integrated “Signaling / Non-signaling Tester” requirement statement [6][7][13][18][50][55][87].
### Supported details
| Radar-technology change | Measurement capability implicated by the passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| FMCW radar and digital echo generation | The radar test setup needs digital echo generation for FMCW radar, with generated distance from the radar-under-test air gap value up to 3000 m [6]. | [6] |
| Longer / dynamic artificial object scenarios | The AREG800A is described as dynamic artificial object generation, using hybrid short-distance analog stepped delay line for `< 17 m` and fully digital implementation for longer distances up to `3000 m` [6]. | [6] |
| Wider radar IF bandwidth | The AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth depends on option and is `1 GHz`, `2 GHz`, or `5 GHz`, with measured overrange of `1.2 GHz`, `2.2 GHz`, or `5.2 GHz` [50]. | [50] |
| Higher-frequency automotive radar bands | The supported RF frequency bands include `24 GHz to 24.25 GHz`, `76 GHz to 81 GHz`, and external frontend coverage `24 GHz to 44 GHz`, so the measurement setup must match the radar band being tested [50]. | [50] |
| More complex object / channel configurations | One AREG800A base unit supports up to 4 conventional mmWave frontends, up to 8 QAT100 frontends, or up to 8 FE44S external frontends configured as 4 TX and 4 RX pairs [50]. | [50] |
| Doppler / velocity requirements | Each artificial object supports individual Doppler frequency shift, velocity setting range with AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63 is `±500 km/h`, velocity step size is `0.001 km/h`, Doppler frequency offset accuracy is `< 1 Hz` in the IF domain excluding frontend, and velocity accuracy is `< 0.05 km/h` under the stated 78 GHz / 79 GHz conditions [55]. | [55] |
| Beamforming / phased-array radar directionality | Beamforming is described as increasing antenna gain by bundling transmitted energy and directing it toward the user, and the cited solution-level test view includes beamformer IC verification for phased array antennas plus 2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification [87]. | [87] |
| Communication-sensing convergence such as ISAC | ISAC integrates sensing capability into communications networks, and its challenges include high bandwidth, radar equation, power density, spectrum coexistence, and waveform design [18]. | [18] |
| Satellite / 6G-style convergence | Multi-function satellite services may integrate a joint waveform such as communications plus radar sensing, or use a communications method to provide timing information [71]. | [71] |
| Signaling tester role | The CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD, and it provides NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements plus WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements [7]. | [7] |
| Non-signaling tester role | The CMX500 GPRF Generator is a non-signaling use case that generates ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveform, supporting R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [13]. | [13] |
### 推論
【推論】If radar evolves toward FMCW, wider bandwidth, more objects, and Doppler-sensitive scenarios, the relevant measurement capability shifts from only RF power/frequency checks toward radar echo generation with distance, object, bandwidth, and Doppler controls, because AREG800A provides FMCW digital echo generation, up to `3000 m` generated distance, `1 GHz` / `2 GHz` / `5 GHz` IF bandwidth, and individual Doppler / velocity specifications [6][50][55].
【推論】If radar evolves toward phased-array or beam-steered operation, the tester setup needs antenna / beamforming verification in addition to RF signal analysis, because the cited beamforming passage describes phased-array beamformer IC verification and 2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification [87].
【推論】If radar evolves toward ISAC or communications-plus-radar sensing, a signaling / non-signaling tester context may need to combine protocol/network-emulation or waveform-generation roles with sensing-related RF requirements, because CMX500 covers signaling and non-signaling waveform / TX workflows while ISAC and MFSS passages describe sensing integrated into communications and joint communications-plus-radar waveforms [7][13][18][71].
